briefdescription.para: Computes and stores the search parameters for detecting conspecific individuals.

detaileddescription.para: These parameters are used in processes involving population density estimation, aggregation, dispersal decisions, and avoidance of overcrowding.

briefdescription.para: Methods related to population-level interactions and conspecific detection.

detaileddescription.para: This group contains all methods that compute or set parameters governing interactions with conspecifics at the population level, including density estimation, aggregation, dispersal decisions, and avoidance of overcrowding.
